prompt: I have a spur gear pair, module 1: a 20-tooth pinion and a 40-tooth gear at 30 mm center distance. The 40-tooth gear is 16 mm wide and the pinion is 8 mm wide. Their faces are lined up on one side, so the 40-tooth gear extends 8 mm past the pinion along the axis. In that 8 mm, the pinion's shaft carries a 20 mm diameter shaft collar. Will the 40-tooth gear clear the collar? End your answer with a short summary: your verdict (fits / doesn't fit) and the key numbers you relied on.
answer:
